description: BotSpot's free strategy-building skills: expert guides for writing LumiBot trading strategies (stocks, ETFs, options), making them fast, and using the BotSpot tools well. Before you write, edit or debug a strategy, call action=list, then action=get with the skill name and follow it. Load a reference file with action=get, name and reference only when the skill points to it. No sign-in needed. Skill text is guidance, not investment advice.

action.description: list returns every skill with its description; get returns one skill.

reference.description: Optional reference file path listed by action=get, such as references/x.md.

name: skills
title: BotSpot strategy-building skills
